final_answer:
Updated only `src/click/core.py`: `MultiCommand.format_commands` now accepts keyword-only `include_hidden: bool = False`. Hidden commands remain excluded by default and appear when `True`.

No untracked files remain.

arguments.command:
$env:PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE = '1'; $env:PYTHONPATH = "$PWD\src"; @'
import inspect
import click

command = click.Group('cli', commands={
    'visible': click.Command('visible', help='Visible help'),
    'hidden': click.Command('hidden', help='Hidden help', hidden=True),
})
ctx = click.Context(command)
for kwargs, expected in [({}, False), ({'include_hidden': False}, False), ({'include_hidden': True}, True)]:
    formatter = click.HelpFormatter()
    command.format_commands(ctx, formatter, **kwargs)
    output = formatter.getvalue()
    assert 'Commands:' in output and 'visible' in output, output
    assert ('hidden' in output) == expected, output
parameter = inspect.signature(click.MultiCommand.format_commands).parameters['include_hidden']
assert parameter.kind is inspect.Parameter.KEYWORD_ONLY
assert parameter.default is False
print('Focused checks passed')
'@ | python -; python -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider tests\test_commands.py tests\test_help.py; git diff --check; git status --short
arguments.description: Verify hidden command formatting and existing command/help tests
